note: Live-session recording (series/tools/rec). prepare/teardown run on the laptop, not recorded. Passwords are never in this file: the owner types the connection string once when prepare asks (Server=10.50.0.30,1433;Database=master;UID=<login>;<the login's password entry>;Encrypt=yes;TrustServerCertificate=yes); prepare keeps it in the MG_SQL_BASE variable of this session and derives SQL_CONNECTION_STRING for each database; teardown removes both. T-SQL set-up runs on CON-SQL01 over PowerShell Direct as the lab Administrator with Windows authentication (SQL Server's own sysadmin group is Domain Admins). Episode login: lab_demo, made sysadmin for this episode only. The package itself runs under Windows authentication on CON-SQL01. The SSISDB catalog password is typed by the owner in SSMS (never in this file).
prepare: $sql = { param($vm, $text) Invoke-Command -VMName $vm -Credential $cred -ArgumentList $text -ScriptBlock { param($t) $c = New-Object System.Data.SqlClient.SqlConnection 'Server=localhost;Integrated Security=SSPI;TrustServerCertificate=True'; $c.Open(); try { foreach ($b in ($t -split '(?im)^\s*GO\s*$')) { if ($b.Trim()) { $m = $c.CreateCommand(); $m.CommandText = $b; $m.CommandTimeout = 600; [void]$m.ExecuteNonQuery() } } } finally { $c.Close() } } }
& $sql 'CON-SQL01' "IF SUSER_ID(N'lab_demo') IS NULL THROW 50000, N'Create the login lab_demo first (episode 3 demo.md, setup step 3; owner types its password off camera).', 1;"
& $sql 'CON-SQL01' "IF IS_SRVROLEMEMBER(N'sysadmin', N'lab_demo') = 0 ALTER SERVER ROLE sysadmin ADD MEMBER lab_demo;"

if (-not (Invoke-Command -VMName CON-SQL01 -Credential $cred { Get-Service MsDtsServer160 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue })) { $iso = Get-ChildItem E:\MGLab\iso\sql -Filter *.iso | Select-Object -First 1; Get-VMDvdDrive -VMName CON-SQL01 | Select-Object -First 1 | Set-VMDvdDrive -Path $iso.FullName; Invoke-Command -VMName CON-SQL01 -Credential $cred { $d = Get-Volume | Where-Object DriveType -eq 'CD-ROM' | ForEach-Object { "$($_.DriveLetter):\setup.exe" } | Where-Object { Test-Path $_ } | Select-Object -First 1; Start-Process $d '/QS /ACTION=Install /FEATURES=IS /IACCEPTSQLSERVERLICENSETERMS' -Wait }; Get-VMDvdDrive -VMName CON-SQL01 | Select-Object -First 1 | Set-VMDvdDrive -Path $null }

if (-not (Get-CimInstance Win32_Product -Filter "Name LIKE 'Microsoft OLE DB Driver 19%'")) { throw 'Install Microsoft OLE DB Driver 19 for SQL Server on the laptop and on CON-SQL01 first (installer from Learn).' }
& $sql 'CON-SQL01' "IF DB_ID(N'SSISDB') IS NULL THROW 50000, N'Create the SSIS catalog first: SSMS > Integration Services Catalogs > Create Catalog (owner types the catalog secret off camera).', 1;"
if (-not $ispac) { throw 'Build PartnerSalesProject in Visual Studio (Build > Build Solution, project saved under this episode folder) so that PartnerSalesProject.ispac exists.' }
if (-not $env:MG_SQL_BASE) { $env:MG_SQL_BASE = Read-Host 'Connection string for lab_demo on 10.50.0.30,1433 (typed off camera, never saved; format in the note of record.json)' -MaskInput }
